chunks: If God were to punish men for their inequity He would not leave a single moving thing on earth. Yet He gives them latitude for a time ordained. When that time is come, there will not be a moment's delay nor a moment's haste.
ai.seo_question: Why does God delay punishment for human sins?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Allah's *Hilm* (forbearance) as a deliberate act of mercy rather than weakness, granting humanity time for repentance (*tawbah) before the inevitable Day of Judgment. It underscores the certainty of the *Ajal* (appointed term), a core eschatological concept where divine justice is executed with precision, ensuring no soul is wronged. This delay serves as a practical invitation for believers to utilize this interim period for spiritual preparation and moral rectification.
